findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Celebrate with a cake to remember." → 3 lines (6 words, 72px); "Small moments. Sweet memories." → 3 lines (4 words, 48px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 5 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Ice cream cakes for every celebration" above "Celebrate with a cake to remember."; "A tropical scoop of vibe" above "Hello, sunshine."; "The Cold Stone feeling" above "Small moments. Sweet memories."; "All categories" above "The full menu"; "Every flavor" above "All flavors"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "02", "/ 03"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 2 tiny uppercase letter-spaced label(s): "Why people love us", "Free app"
findings.fix: Prefer sentence case at body size.

findings.message: 10 gradient fill(s): div.hero-blob-a.pointer-events-none → radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(255, 220, 50, 0.08), rgba(255, 220, 50, 0.08) 35%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)) | div.hero-blob-b.pointer-events-none → radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(28, 79, 138, 0.45), rgba(28, 79, 138, 0.45) 35%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)) | div.pointer-events-none.absolute → linear-gradient(to top, oklab(0.231324 -0.0156847 -0.0611215 / 0.3) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 44 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.relative.aspect-[5/4] → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | button.relative.size-12 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgb(9, 42, 8 | div.group.relative → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 2 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): footer.mt-6.flex 614px | div.pointer-events-none.absolute 1440px rule
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 1 box(es) drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Prefer a filled surface or no box.

findings.message: 6 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (section #fbfaf5).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Chocolate Ice Cream with chocolate shavi" 4:1 needs 4.5:1; "Sweet Cream Ice Cream with pecans, brown" 4:1 needs 4.5:1; "Cake Batter Ice Cream with rainbow sprin" 4:1 needs 4.5:1; "Chocolate Ice Cream with peanut butter, " 4:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.1:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 4 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: 9 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (it is at 0% opacity).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

findings.message: No visible button in the first phone screen.
findings.fix: On a phone the first screen still holds the headline, the supporting sentence and the action; move navigation into one row or a menu so it does not push them down.

findings.message: No headline found in the first viewport.
findings.fix: The first screen needs a clear focal statement or image.

findings.message: The page has no visible h1.
findings.fix: Give the first screen a clear title in an h1 that says what this is (a name with what it does, the product with what it is for, the event with its date and place).

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 54 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "Ice cream by the scoop", "Browse signature creations and treats.", "Browse all flavors", "Flavor tag"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
